hostDependenciesNotShipped.evidence: Stage VERSION reports packaging host glibc 2.39; upstream portable bundle recipe excludes libc, loader, libm, libdl, pthread, rt, libresolv. No minimum compatible glibc is claimed.

Pinned build recipe explicitly excludes host-coupled GL/EGL/GLX/DRM/GBM, CUDA/NVIDIA driver libraries and display libraries; NVIDIA ICD is host-provided. Vulkan loader is bundled by recipe. Host GPU/display compatibility is not guaranteed.
The package carries several private audio/client libraries, but actual audio backends/devices, session services and display server are host services. No host compatibility guarantee is implied.

archive.bundledVulkanLoader: 1.4.363 (vkEnumerateInstanceVersion); upstream mpv requires >= 1.4.309 at build time, and the loader is bundled because the runtime links it and an older host loader would disable mpv's Vulkan path
archive.modification: Only the FFmpeg family is replaced (same tag n9.0.2, the same configure flags plus --enable-openssl) and OpenSSL 3.0 from the Ubuntu 22.04 baseline is added; the published archive was configured without a TLS backend, so https streams could not be opened. The mpv fork, libplacebo, shaderc, libass and libvulkan bytes are the upstream archive's.

tlsBuild.buildEnvironment: Isolated Ubuntu 22.04 rootfs under WSL chroot; equivalent FFmpeg build body from packaging/mpv/build-tls-archive.sh, four compiler jobs. Docker was unavailable.
tlsBuild.tlsEvidence: libavformat NEEDED includes libssl.so.3 and libcrypto.so.3; actual certificate-verified HTTPS HEVC playback succeeded.

components.recipePatchEvidence: No current-run upstream build recipe or exact source patch evidence is retained. The local Mikai wrapper verifies the archive SHA-256, extracts in an owned directory, removes versioned libmpv members, removes host-provided libc/loader/graphics/driver and Qt SONAME patterns, copies internal symlinks to regular files, validates ELF magic, runs patchelf --set-rpath `$ORIGIN` on each retained ELF library and records its resulting SHA-256 in its cache stamp. Stage final hashes are in package SHA256SUMS.
